Tests are green. 

## Summary

I agreed with the finding and addressed it. The inbound `title` enum→`String` conversion was being done inline in `updateOwner` while the create path relied on MapStruct's implicit enum→String conversion — two different mechanisms in two places, inconsistent with how `normalizeTelephone`/`normalizeEmail`/`applyAddressFields` centralize inbound transformations in the mapper.

**Changes:**
- **`OwnerMapper.java`** — Added a `@Named("mapTitle")` default method that unwraps `OwnerFieldsDto.TitleEnum` to its canonical `String` value (or `null`), with Javadoc matching its siblings. Made the conversion explicit on `toOwner(OwnerFieldsDto)` via `@Mapping(target = "title", source = "title", qualifiedByName = "mapTitle")` instead of relying on an implicit built-in conversion.
- **`OwnerRestControllerV1.updateOwner`** — Now calls `ownerMapper.mapTitle(ownerFieldsDto.getTitle())`, the same pattern as the adjacent `normalizeTelephone`/`normalizeEmail` calls.

Both create and update now share one definition of the inbound `title` mapping, restoring create/update symmetry. The acceptance test (`coreComposesSalutation`) and the full suite remain green — `BUILD SUCCESS`.
